description: Radiology chest X-ray abnormality classification model. PNG/JPG chest X-ray image input is analyzed with TorchXRayVision resnet50-res512-all to return a Grad-CAM overlay image plus multi-label classification probabilities for 14 thoracic findings.
disease: chest x-ray, thoracic abnormality, atelectasis, cardiomegaly, effusion, infiltration, mass, nodule, pneumonia, pneumothorax, consolidation, edema, emphysema, fibrosis, pleural thickening, hernia
